svg.title: Azure Virtual WAN and ISV NVA transparent-routing demo
svg.desc: Customer and ISV ownership, static workload VM IPs, illustrative dynamically assigned NVA IPs, Azure service icons, an optional second NVA, and intended traffic paths. Routing Intent can change the actual NVA path.
svg.text: Azure Virtual WAN / ISV NVA transparent-routing demo
Workload UDR → ILB → NVA → hub-learned route
Intended paths only: Routing Intent can override the NVA next hop; verify with packet captures.
Demo: one non-zonal NVA. Dashed = optional additional NVA.
* NVA private IPs are dynamically allocated; shown addresses are examples.
Each NVA has an outbound public IP; workload VMs have none.
